description: Lists deals in the tenant CRM — an opportunity moving through a pipeline. Cursor-paginated: limit 1-100, opaque cursor from the previous page. Filters: q, pipeline_id, stage_id, status. Needs crm:read on the organization. Every item carries an absolute url. Money is in minor units: `value_minor: 10000` with `currency: "USD"` is $100.00, not $10,000.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page

name: commsharbor_crm_deals_list
